scope: 24 additional meaningful body figures across eight Answer topics; shared source/card text unchanged.

placements.description: A woman studies beside a window with an open book and notebook. Her focused attention reflects the value of understanding Latter-day Saint beliefs in their own words and bringing sincere questions into the light.
